name: Kazami
source:
"Wishing alone will not change anything. But that would be a step to move forward."

A youkai who lives in Oto Jingu Shrine. He is strict with everyone and has good morals, but he also would stop at nothing to achieve his goals.

He calls Kuro "ane" and refers to Mashiro as his "favorite pillow."

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_kazami.png]official website[/url]]

One of Mashiro's love interests.
